description: This file defines the IdSpanCodec class responsible for serializing and deserializing IdSpan instances in the Orleans framework. It includes methods for writing, reading, and raw serialization of IdSpan objects, leveraging buffers and wire protocols.

classes.name: IdSpanCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing IdSpan objects within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an IdSpan value into a buffer with field framing, including type and size headers.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes an IdSpan value into a buffer without field framing, writing size, hash code, and bytes.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Deserializes an IdSpan value from a buffer without field framing, reading size, hash code, and payload.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes an IdSpan value from a buffer with expected wire type, reading size, hash code, and payload.
